title: Skeletal Mesh Retargeting Preview
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a skeletal mesh retargeting preview tool. The scene demonstrates how a source skeleton's animation can be retargeted onto a target skeleton with different proportions.

SCENE SETUP:
- Dark background (0x1a1a2e) with a ground grid (GridHelper, size 20, divisions 20, color 0x444466).
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 4, 10), looking at origin.
- Lights: AmbientLight (0x404060, 0.5) and DirectionalLight (0xffffff, 0.8) at (5, 10, 5).
- OrbitControls for camera manipulation.

SKELETON SYSTEM:
- Build TWO programmatic stick-figure skeletons using Three.js Bone hierarchies, each visualized with SkeletonHelper:
  - SOURCE skeleton (left side, x=-3): 6 bones — root(hip), spine, chest, head, leftArm, rightArm. Total height ~3 units. Colored blue (0x4488ff).
  - TARGET skeleton (right side, x=+3): Same bone structure but different proportions — torso 1.4x longer, arms 0.7x shorter, head bone 1.2x larger offset. Colored green (0x44ff88).
- Each skeleton is wrapped in a SkinnedMesh with a simple capsule/cylinder geometry per bone segment.

ANIMATION SYSTEM:
- Source skeleton plays a looping procedural animation: a simple wave/idle cycle where the spine sways sinusoidally (rotation.z ±15°), arms rotate up and down (rotation.x ±45°), and head nods (rotation.x ±10°). Animation runs via a custom update loop (not AnimationMixer) using elapsed time.
- Retargeting: Each frame, copy the source bone LOCAL rotations to the corresponding target bones. The target bones keep their own rest-pose positions (different proportions) but adopt the source rotations — this is the retargeting.
- A scaling factor slider adjusts how much of the source rotation is applied to the target (0% = rest pose, 100% = full copy, 150% = exaggerated).

UI CONTROLS (DOM overlay, top-left panel):
- Play/Pause button (id='btn-play-pause') toggling animation.
- Speed slider (id='slider-speed', range 0.1 to 3.0, default 1.0, step 0.1) controlling animation speed.
- Retarget Blend slider (id='slider-blend', range 0 to 150, default 100, step 1) — percentage of source rotation applied to target.
- A dropdown (id='select-bone') listing bone names: 'all', 'spine', 'chest', 'head', 'leftArm', 'rightArm'. When a specific bone is selected, ONLY that bone's rotation is retargeted; others on the target stay at rest pose. Default: 'all'.
- A checkbox (id='chk-show-source', checked by default) to show/hide the source skeleton.
- Display labels: current time (id='label-time'), current speed (id='label-speed'), current blend % (id='label-blend').

STATE MANAGEMENT — expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- isPlaying: boolean
- animationTime: number (elapsed animation time in seconds)
- speed: number (current speed multiplier)
- blendFactor: number (0 to 1.5, where 1.0 = 100%)
- selectedBone: string ('all' or bone name)
- sourceVisible: boolean
- sourceBones: object mapping bone names to {rotation: {x,y,z}} in radians for current frame
- targetBones: object mapping bone names to {rotation: {x,y,z}} in radians for current frame
- retargetError: number — sum of absolute rotation differences across all bones between source and (target / blendFactor), should be near 0 when blend=100% and selectedBone='all'
- boneCount: number (6)
- frameCount: number (incremented each render frame)

KEYBOARD:
- Space: toggle play/pause
- R: reset animation time to 0
- Up/Down arrows: increase/decrease speed by 0.1 (clamped to slider range)

IMPORTANT: All bone rotations must be NaN-free. The retarget error computation must handle division safely. Animation time must advance monotonically when playing.
physics_constraints: Bone rotations must remain NaN-free at all times. Animation time must be monotonically increasing when playing. Retarget error should approach 0 when blend=100% and selectedBone='all'. Blend factor must be clamped to [0, 1.5]. Speed must be clamped to [0.1, 3.0].
